configurations.name: keyhole-app
configurations.//: The renderer dev server, for developing the UI the desktop app ships. Not a way to serve Keyhole to browsers as a product.

configurations.name: keyhole-sync-server
configurations.//: The sync server with its own defaults — 0.0.0.0:8787, ./data/keyhole.sqlite — for checking the status page and the bind address. `npm run dev:server` is the loopback-pinned variant.

configurations.name: keyhole-sync-server-local
configurations.//: The loopback-pinned variant (`npm run dev:server`, KEYHOLE_HOST=127.0.0.1). The default for working on this machine: registration is open by default, so the 0.0.0.0 config above offers account creation to the whole LAN.

configurations.name: keyhole-app-standalone
configurations.//: Built output, served the way an installed copy is. The dev server above deliberately has no service worker, so this is the only config where offline and install behaviour can be checked.
